rows.name: Embroidered Beetle
rows.purpose: Hidden-field reflection threatens the player or unfinished line; its territory is retained on capture.
rows.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: One original static source body for the Ukraine Atlas enemy art study in a top-down arcade game.
Primary request: Create exactly ONE complete individual enemy body on actual transparent alpha, square PNG requested at 1024x1024. No scene, ground, contact shadow, checkerboard, text, label, logo or watermark. This is a fictional craft-inspired game actor, not a historical artifact or real military design.
Style: Cohesive modern 16-bit pixel-art vocabulary: deliberately broad square color clusters, stepped silhouette edges, sparse large woodcut/embroidered geometric ornament, bright readable rims. Visually compact and readable at 24 and 32 pixels. Limited palette aim around 16-20 colors, no photographic grain, tiny realistic noise, glossy airbrushed gradients or dense filigree.
Palette: Ukraine Atlas ivory #f3ecdf, indigo charcoal #29343c and #252d3e, warm amber #e5ba6c, muted turquoise #90b7bf, restrained coral #d98277. Make the substantial body visibly bright against both a dark field and a busy revealed painting. Coral north cue differentiates these hostile fantasy shapes from friendly player birds.
Camera and framing: Orthographic straight overhead, NORTH exactly at image top. No side/front/isometric view. Center the complete body on the image-frame center. Target outer substantial extent around 78-82% of the square, with at least 8% clear transparent margin around every appendage. For broad roles occupy at least 70% width; keep shapes thick, not miniature inside large padding. No clipped limb, antenna, wing, root or ornament.
Constraints: Static full silhouette only. No baked speed trail, damage, projectile, beam, explosion, motion blur, multiple frames or background effect. No copied character, official symbol, flag, insignia, letters or Z marking. Invented motifs only; no authenticity claim. Preserve a simple forward/north feature. Animation anchors and mechanics will be separate future work.
Existing role: Field hunter (bouncer).
Art-study name: Embroidered Beetle.
Existing behavior, only for visual intent: Hidden-field reflection threatens the player or unfinished line; its territory is retained on capture.
Subject: A broad oval shield-backed beetle of dark carved wood and warm bronze, viewed straight down. Six short stout legs form three clear pairs. Two small solid antennae point NORTH. Its broad ivory-edged shell carries just one large coral diamond and two simple turquoise stitch bands. The body reads as a compact six-legged armored beetle, no tank tracks, no wings.
